confirmedFindings.title: Concurrent Timer and Threshold Flush Duplicates CDR Rows
confirmedFindings.body: Removing the isFlushing lock and taking a shallow copy `[...this.queue]` before awaiting writeToDb allows concurrent timer and threshold triggers to process the exact same CDR items twice, resulting in duplicate database records.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use atomic queue draining: `const batch = this.queue.splice(0);` or enforce a mutex lock around flush operations.
